title: Queue launch-check display state
summary: Queue WebView now presents deferred-only source/output launch checks as Launch Check instead of generic Review while preserving true blocked and review rows.
reason: Deferred runtime checks are normal backend-owned launch validation; labeling every deferred row Review hid actionable review rows behind a generic warning state.
behavior_before: Rows whose only warning was deferred source/output launch checks rendered with a Review chip and generic Launch checks deferred evidence, so large batches looked like they all needed operator review.
behavior_after: Deferred-only launch-check rows render with a Launch Check chip, route-first evidence such as bitrate over threshold plus checks at launch, and are excluded from true Queue review rows while remaining visible through deferred-check filtering.
manual_validation: git diff --check touched files - passed with CRLF normalization warnings only
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due unrelated uncovered dirty files outside this packet
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView queue review/table/CSS changes and the row-detail smoke assertions in this packet; backend queue policy and runtime launch checks were not changed.
notes:
Classify deferred-only launch checks separately from true review rows.
Render Launch Check state and route-first launch-check evidence in the Queue table.
Add Launch Check queue-state chip styling.
Cover Launch Check rows, bad-extension blockers, true review rows, and deferred-check filtering.
